source_file: docs/英一小作文/2021英一小作文.md
prompt: A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an e-mail to make some suggestions.
key_points: 祝贺对方毕业并引出为在华求职提建议的目的
建议制定清晰的职业规划并了解目标行业与企业
推荐专业求职招聘平台并提醒尽早办理工作签证
register_analysis: 写给刚毕业外国朋友的私人咨询信函，语域随和自然、亲切真诚。首段直接祝贺毕业切入，严禁自我介绍；次段用 it is crucial to / function as indispensable tools / strongly recommend 提出务实建议；尾段送上真挚祝愿。
vocabulary_benchmark: launch one's career, educational background, vacancy updates, post-study work visa, mandatory requirement, land one's dream job.
extractable_expressions: Congratulations on your graduation from college!
Hearing that you intend to [goal], I am pleased to share some suggestions that may contribute to [objective].
To begin with, it is crucial to [action] by taking [factors] into account.
Secondly, [resources] function as indispensable tools, enabling you to [benefit].
Moreover, I strongly recommend [action] as early as possible, since [reason].
official_model:
Dear Jack,

    Congratulations on your graduation from college! Hearing that you intend to launch your career in China, I am pleased to share some suggestions that may contribute to your job search.

    To begin with, it is crucial to craft a clear career plan by taking your educational background, strengths and interests into account, based on which you can then collect information about your desired industries and companies. Secondly, a variety of recruitment websites, particularly those tailored for international job seekers in China, function as indispensable tools, enabling you to receive vacancy updates and submit your job applications efficiently. Moreover, I strongly recommend applying for a post-study work visa as early as possible, since it is a mandatory requirement for employment in China.

    I hope my suggestions above would be of benefit to you. Wish you all the success in landing your dream job soon!

Best regards,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2020英二小作文.md
relationship: 同侪群体/留学生同学 (Peer Group)
prompt: Suppose you are planning a tour of a historical site for a group of international students. Write them an email to 1) tell them about the site, and 2) give them some tips for the tour.
key_points: 表明写信目的，交代选定的历史名胜古迹（兵马俑）
介绍古迹历史底蕴与壮丽看点
给出避开高峰、早起出行、租用多语言讲解器等实用建议
register_analysis: 面向留学生同学的出行建议与景点推荐，用语自然亲切、诚挚得体。重点在于将文化介绍与具象出行 Tips 结合，突出历史文化底蕴与实操价值。
vocabulary_benchmark: historical attraction, archaeological discoveries, life-size clay warriors, fascinating glimpse, glorious past, multilingual audio guide.
extractable_expressions: I am writing to inform you of the historical attraction to visit—[Site], one of the greatest [category] of all time—and share some travel tips.
Located to [location], [Site] is a massive collection of [features], offering a fascinating glimpse into [culture/history].
To get a better view of [attraction], you may consider [action].
In addition, it is also advisable to [action], which will certainly make your trip informative.
official_model:
Dear Friends,

    I am so delighted that you trust me to arrange your trip. I am writing to inform you of the historical attraction to visit—the Terracotta Army, one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of all time—and share some travel tips.

    Located to the east of downtown Xi'an, the Terracotta Army is a massive collection of life-size clay warriors and horses buried in the tomb of China's First Emperor. It offers a fascinating glimpse into the country's glorious past. To get a better view of these breathtaking sculptures, you may consider avoiding public holidays in China or setting out early if you have to visit the museum on those days. In addition, it is also advisable to rent a multilingual audio guide at the ticket office, which will certainly make your trip informative.

    I hope you will enjoy this unforgettable cultural journey. Feel free to contact me if you need any further assistance.

Best regards,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2012英二小作文.md
relationship: 消费者对客服部门 (Consumer to Business)
prompt: Suppose you have found something wrong with the electronic dictionary that you bought from an online store the other day. Write an email to the customer service center to 1) make a complaint, and 2) demand a prompt solution.
key_points: 交代网购电子词典信息并正式提出质量投诉
详细列举产品频繁关机、客服敷衍等故障事实
提出明确合理诉求（换全新机或全额退款）及解决期限
register_analysis: 商务维权投诉信，措辞严谨规范、不卑不亢，兼具交涉力量与礼貌素养。用事实说话，准确运用缺陷与诉求词汇，不作无理人身攻击。
vocabulary_benchmark: electronic dictionary, customer service center, lodge a complaint, prompt solution, erratic and persistent shutdowns, immediate replacement, full refund.
extractable_expressions: I am writing this email to lodge a formal complaint regarding [product] that I purchased from your online store on [date].
I had placed high trust in [company/brand]; nevertheless, this purchase has brought me severe frustration.
Upon receiving the parcel, I was dismayed to discover that [defect].
Under these circumstances, I feel fully justified in requesting an immediate replacement or a full refund.
official_model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    I am writing this email to lodge a formal complaint regarding the electronic dictionary (Model P900 PRO) that I purchased from your online flagship store on November 6th.

    I had placed high trust in the quality of your products; nevertheless, this gadget has proved severely defective. Only two days after its arrival, the dictionary began to suffer from erratic and persistent automatic shutdowns, which caused severe inconvenience to my English studies. Furthermore, your online customer service representatives failed to provide any constructive solution when I inquired yesterday.

    Under these circumstances, I feel fully justified in demanding an immediate replacement with a brand-new device or a full refund. I expect your prompt settlement within three business days.

Yours faithfully,
Zhang Wei

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2018英二小作文.md
prompt: Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and will not be able to visit Professor Smith. Write him an email to 1) apologize and explain the situation, and 2) suggest a future meeting.
key_points: 开门见山说明无法如期拜访，诚恳致歉
客观解释突发流感遵医嘱静养的真实事由
表达遗憾并委婉提议重新约定下次会面时间
register_analysis: 学生致教授的半正式致歉信，用语礼貌得体、客气真诚，既体现对师长日程安排的敬重，又显自然得体。解释原因客观具体，补救举措周到。
vocabulary_benchmark: apologize for, necessitate changes, busy schedule, acute influenza, bed rest, cancel travel plan, rearrange the appointment.
extractable_expressions: I am writing to apologize for not being able to [event] as planned.
I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience it causes you and any changes it necessitates in your busy schedule.
Regrettably, [unforeseen event], leaving me little choice but to [action].
I was wondering whether we could rearrange the appointment at your earliest convenience.
official_model:
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am writing to apologize for not being able to visit you tomorrow as planned. I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience it causes you and any changes it necessitates in your busy schedule.

    I had been eagerly looking forward to our meeting; unexpectedly, I woke up with a high fever and severe headache this morning. After a clinic examination, I was diagnosed with acute influenza. The physician strongly advised me to take bed rest, leaving me little choice but to cancel my travel plan.

    It is truly regrettable that we cannot meet as scheduled. I was wondering whether we could rearrange the appointment for next week if your timetable allows. Please let me know when you will be available.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2021英二小作文.md
prompt: Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an e-mail to Jack, an international student, to 1) invite him to participate, and 2) tell him the details.
key_points: 以读书会组织者身份正式邀请 Jack 参加线上会议，明确时间与平台
介绍会议主题（分享本国著名作家及作品，促进跨文化交流）
说明会议具体安排及期待对方加入
register_analysis: 面向留学生同侪的活动邀请，语气亲切随和、诚挚得体。杜绝老派生硬官僚外交辞令（严禁对同学使用 favor us with a reply），采用现代同侪交流风格，结语使用 Best regards,。
vocabulary_benchmark: organizer, monthly reading session, online meeting, cross-cultural exchanges, broaden literary horizons, literature enthusiast, unique perspectives.
extractable_expressions: As an organizer of [activity], I am writing to invite you to our online meeting scheduled for [time] via [platform].
With the theme of [Theme], this gathering aims to expose participants to [field].
As a [role/identity], you are warmly invited to share your unique perspectives on [topic].
We would be thrilled if you could accept our invitation. Looking forward to our discussion!
official_model:
Dear Jack,

    As an organizer of our monthly reading session, I am writing to invite you to our online meeting scheduled for next Friday from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. via Zoom.

    With the theme of 'A Famous Writer from Your Country', this gathering aims to expose participants to writers and works from diverse cultural backgrounds. Attendees will engage in cross-cultural discussions to broaden their literary horizons. As a passionate literature enthusiast, you are warmly invited to share your unique perspectives on contemporary fiction.

    Detailed meeting arrangements and the agenda link have been sent to your email. We would be thrilled if you could join us. Looking forward to our lively discussion!

Best regards,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2010英二小作文.md
prompt: You have just come back from the U.S. as a member of a Sino-American cultural exchange program. Write a letter to your American colleague to 1) express your thanks for his/her warm reception; 2) welcome him/her to visit China in due course.
key_points: 对文化交流期间美方同事的热情款待表达由衷感谢
深情回顾陪同参访与跨文化交流的温暖细节
热忱邀请对方适时访华并承诺担任向导
register_analysis: 跨文化同侪/同事间的致谢信，语气真诚亲切、谦逊得体，洋溢着开放包容的国际交流视野与深厚友谊。
vocabulary_benchmark: sincere gratitude, warm hospitality, generous assistance, cultural exchange program, cultural diversity, cherished memories, hospitable guide.
extractable_expressions: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to you for your warm hospitality and generous assistance during my recent visit to [place].
I can still recall vividly how you [action], which made my stay both rewarding and memorable.
Should you have the opportunity to visit China in due course, please do let me know so that I can serve as your guide and return your wonderful kindness.
Wish you health and happiness.
official_model:
Dear Jane,

    I would like to express my sincere gratitude to you for your warm hospitality and generous assistance during my recent visit to the United States as part of the cultural exchange program.

    I can still recall vividly how you accompanied me through university campuses and shared insightful perspectives on cultural diversity. Thanks to your thoughtful guidance, I was able to adapt smoothly to the local academic environment and gained profound insights into American higher education. This journey has left me with cherished memories.

    Should you have the opportunity to visit China in due course, please do let me know so that I can serve as your guide and return your wonderful kindness. Wish you health and happiness.

Best regards,
Zhang Wei

source_file: docs/考研小作文微观语料库_模块功能句与场景语素.md#6.7
relationship: 应聘者对用人单位 (Applicant to Organization)
prompt: Suppose you want to apply for the position of an English Teaching Assistant at an international school. Write a letter to: 1) Introduce your educational background and qualifications; 2) Express your willingness to take an interview.
key_points: 说明获悉招聘信息并正式提出助教岗位申请
阐述专业学术成绩、英语专八资质及辅导经验
随信附上简历并礼貌表达期待获得面试机会
register_analysis: 涉外助教职位申请公文，具有规范的正式职场公文语域。态度不卑不亢、专业自信，行文逻辑清晰，动词承重力强。
vocabulary_benchmark: position available, submit formal application, TEM-8, pedagogical competencies, peer tutor, interpersonal tact, enclosed resume, favorable review.
extractable_expressions: Having learned from [source] that [position] is currently available, I am writing with keen interest to submit my formal application.
Having achieved [qualification] and maintained an outstanding academic record, I possess solid [skills] competencies.
In addition, my prior experience as [role] has endowed me with exceptional patience and interpersonal tact.
Enclosed with this letter is my detailed resume for your review. I would genuinely appreciate the opportunity for an interview at your convenience.
official_model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    Having learned from your official portal that an English Teaching Assistant position is currently available, I am writing with keen interest to submit my formal application.

    Having achieved a top-tier score in TEM-8 and maintained an outstanding academic record, I possess proficient bilingual fluency and solid pedagogical competencies. In addition, my prior one-year experience as a peer tutor has endowed me with exceptional patience and interpersonal tact, enabling me to communicate effectively with students from diverse backgrounds. I am fully confident in my capacity to assist your faculty in optimizing classroom efficiency.

    Enclosed with this letter is my detailed resume for your review. I would genuinely appreciate the opportunity for an interview at your convenience.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英一小作文/2023英一小作文.md
relationship: 发布单位对学生大众 (Host to Students)
prompt: Write a notice to recruit a student for Prof. Smith's research project on campus sports activities. Specify the duties and requirements of the job.
key_points: 开篇直陈招募意图与史密斯教授体育研究项目背景
明确助手的岗位职责（问卷分发与数据录入分析）及资质要求
提供报名联系邮箱与截止日期，欢迎积极申请
register_analysis: 校内招募告示规范公文。标题 Notice 居中，无称呼，日期与落款位置规范，语言客观凝练，信息要素闭环齐备。
vocabulary_benchmark: research project, student assistant, campus sports activities, distribute questionnaires, preliminary statistical data entry, proficient communication skills, commit hours.
extractable_expressions: Professor Smith is currently seeking a student assistant for his research project on [subject], which aims to [goal].
The recruited assistant will primarily be responsible for [duty 1], as well as assisting in [duty 2].
Prospective candidates are expected to demonstrate proficient [skills] and [qualities].
Those who are interested are warmly encouraged to send their resumes to [email] prior to [date].
official_model:
Notice
                                                          May 5th, 2023

    Professor Smith is currently seeking a student assistant for his research project on campus sports activities, which aims to examine students' physical exercise habits and preferences.

    The recruited assistant will primarily be responsible for distributing and collecting structured questionnaires across campus, as well as assisting in preliminary statistical data entry. Prospective candidates are expected to demonstrate proficient communication skills, meticulous attention to detail, and familiarity with data analysis tools. Graduate students or senior undergraduates who can commit at least ten hours per week are preferred.

    Those who are interested are warmly encouraged to send their resumes to profsmith@university.edu.cn prior to May 15th.

                                            The Postgraduate Association

source_file: docs/考研小作文微观语料库_模块功能句与场景语素.md#6.9
relationship: 记录人对全体参会人员与存档 (Recorder to Participants)
prompt: Suppose you presided over a meeting regarding the preparations for the Campus Charity Bazaar. Write the meeting minutes to summarize the main decisions.
key_points: 规范书写纪要五大要素头（Date, Place, Present, Absent, Subject）
分条归纳关于场地划分、宣传推广与预算安全的核心决议
署名记录人
register_analysis: 公文会议纪要规范体例。要素头齐备，使用客观陈述与被动语态，逐条清晰提炼会议核心决议，杜绝口语与主观抒情，篇幅紧凑严密（<=120词）。
vocabulary_benchmark: commence, preside over, core resolutions, venue allocation, designated area, promotional campaigns, safety protocols, approved unanimously.
extractable_expressions: The meeting commenced at [time] with [person] presiding over the discussion.
The core resolutions reached are summarized as follows.
Firstly, regarding [issue], it was agreed that [decision].
Secondly, in terms of [issue], [person/team] was assigned to [task].
Lastly, the safety protocols and budget distribution were approved unanimously.
official_model:
Meeting Minutes

Date: May 12th, 2025
Place: Room 204, Student Center
Present: Li Ming, Zhang Wei, and six team members
Absent: Liu Tao (on internship leave)
Subject: Preparations for the Campus Charity Bazaar

    The meeting commenced at 3:00 p.m. with Li Ming presiding over the discussion. The core resolutions reached are summarized as follows.

    Firstly, regarding venue allocation, it was agreed that the central playground will be designated as the primary bazaar area. Secondly, in terms of publicity, Zhang Wei was assigned to design posters and launch online promotional campaigns within three days. Lastly, the safety protocols and budget distribution were approved unanimously.

                                                    Recorder: Li Ming

source_file: docs/英一小作文/2024英一小作文.md
prompt: Read the following email from an international student and write a reply: Dear Li Ming, I've got a class assignment to make an oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist, but I'm not sure how to prepare for it. Can you give me some advice? Thank you for your help. Yours, Paul
key_points: 友好回应求助，欣然表示愿意就口头报告准备提供建议
推荐具体科学家（李时珍），建议按生平背景、主要贡献与历史影响三段式组织
建议融入图表多媒体并提前排练以增强自信，表达良好祝愿
register_analysis: 交互式回信经典范例。针对来信情绪进行共情回应，直陈推荐要点与具体准备步骤。因收信人为留学生同侪，用语亲切随和且礼貌得体，结语采用 Best regards,。
vocabulary_benchmark: oral report, ancient Chinese scientist, empirical research, iconic figure, Compendium of Materia Medica, visual aids, timed rehearsal, informative and compelling.
extractable_expressions: I am thrilled to hear from you and more than willing to share some practical advice on preparing your [presentation/report].
An effective starting point would be focusing on one iconic figure, such as [Person], whose [achievement] offers rich material.
You can divide your presentation into [number] coherent sections: [section 1], [section 2], and [section 3].
To engage your audience, incorporating [visuals/stories] will be highly beneficial.
Furthermore, remember to conduct a timed rehearsal beforehand to build fluency and confidence.
official_model:
Dear Paul,

    I am thrilled to hear from you and more than willing to share some practical advice on preparing your oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist.

    An effective starting point would be focusing on one iconic figure, such as Li Shizhen, whose lifelong dedication to compiling the Compendium of Materia Medica offers inspiring stories. You can divide your presentation into three coherent sections: his personal background, scientific breakthroughs, and lasting legacy. To engage your audience, incorporating concise diagrams and illustrative slides will be highly beneficial. Furthermore, remember to conduct a timed rehearsal beforehand to build fluency and confidence.

    I am confident that your presentation will be informative and compelling. Feel free to reach out if you need further help. Best of luck!

Best regards,
Li Ming
